Article 2.4: Express MAX Accounts (Full Specifications)

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule

⚠️ RETIRED: This account is no longer available for purchase as of July 1, 2026 at market close and has been replaced by STEADY. Accounts already owned before this date keep their existing rules and continue to operate normally. Once an Express MAX account is blown, it cannot be reset. The MAX funded reset option no longer applies to these retiring accounts.

What Is an Express MAX Account?

Express MAX is the fastest path to funding. The evaluation requires only 2 winning funded days (labeled '2 Day Funded'). There is no exhibition stage. The funded account uses an unrealized trailing drawdown until the buffer is reached, then switches to static. Consistency in the funded account is 25%, and traders must accumulate 5 winning days in the funded account before each withdrawal.

Express MAX Evaluation: Key Points
Drawdown Type: Realized Trailing (updates after each trade closes)
Daily Loss Limit: None
Minimum to Pass: 2 Winning Days ('2 Day Funded')
Consistency Rule: 50% (no single session exceeds 50% of the profit target)
No minimum trading days beyond the 2 winning days requirement
News trading: Permitted in evaluation only

Express MAX Funded Account Rules

These rules differ significantly from OG funded accounts. Read carefully.

Drawdown Type: Unrealized Trailing until the buffer is built → switches to Static after buffer is reached
Buffer Amount: Equal to the account's evaluation trailing drawdown (e.g., $2,000 for a 50K account)
Consistency Rule: 25% (funded, sim), based on best day net P&L
Minimum Winning Days Per Payout: 5 (must be accumulated fresh after each withdrawal)
After each payout, the 5-winning-day count RESETS. Trader must accumulate 5 new winning days.
Consistency rule resets per account after each withdrawal. Best Day P&L does NOT reset.
Payout Frequency: Same-day once all conditions are met
What Is a 'Winning Day' in Express MAX Funded?

The same minimum daily net P&L thresholds apply as in Standard MAX:

Account Size	Minimum Net P&L for a Winning Day
$25,000	$100
$50,000	$150
$100,000	$200
$150,000	$250
$250,000	$300
Payout Eligibility: Express MAX Funded (All Must Be Met)
Buffer fully built
Account balance is at least $500 above the buffer
Consistency is within 25%
5 winning days accumulated since last payout (or since account funded)
UNREALIZED TRAILING DRAWDOWN: EXPRESS MAX FUNDED During the buffer-building phase, the Express MAX funded account uses an UNREALIZED trailing drawdown. This means open, unrealized losses count against your drawdown, even before you close a trade. This is more aggressive than the realized (end-of-trade) trailing used in OG accounts. Once your buffer is built, the drawdown becomes static and will not trail further.
